description: Number of ART clients lost to follow-up during the reporting period

configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary",
    "mamba_dim_person",
    "mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT s.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.patient_id IS NOT NULL

        AND p.death_date >= :startDate

  )

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT s.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.patient_id IS NOT NULL

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_dim_person p
      WHERE p.person_id = s.patient_id
        AND p.dead = 1
        AND p.death_date >= :startDate
        AND p.death_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
      WHERE r.patient_id = s.patient_id
        AND r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL
        AND r.art_start_date <= :endDate
  );
